title_zh: 职场商战剧：会议室里的较量
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (7/20): Showdown in the Conference Room
note_en: 用 (yòng, "use") in front of a noun introduces the means of an action, and the whole 用 phrase comes before the main verb: 用数据和逻辑说服了在座的所有人 "won over everyone in the room with data and logic." English puts "with..." after the verb; Chinese puts the tool first and the action second, literally "use data and logic, persuade everyone."
